subject: MAP finalization blocked by procurement hold - escalation checklist
messages:
From: Peter Lane <peter.lane@healthcore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Finalizing MAP and procurement questions for Q4 go-live

Neha — thanks for the sync this morning. Quick recap from our procurement and legal teams: they put a hold on signed MSA until we clarify two items (data retention and audit log access for 3rd-party auditors).

They also asked for a more prescriptive acceptance timeline inside the MAP (current draft is high level). This is causing us to pause internal approvals — including the purchase order.

Can you share a version of the MAP that includes:
- concrete acceptance milestones with owners and dates
- a short risk log that flags the audit evidence we can provide now vs. later
- a suggested credit/contingency if the go-live slips past 11/30

Tracy (procurement) is copied. We are still aligned on product fit — this is purely procurement gating. Appreciate a fast turn here.

– Peter
Senior PM, HealthCore Systems
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Peter Lane <peter.lane@healthcore.com>, Tracy Wu <tracy.wu@healthcore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing MAP and procurement questions for Q4 go-live

Peter / Tracy — thank you, and understood. I attached an updated MAP (HealthCore_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short procurement Q&A (procurement_questions_20261007.pdf) that call out the items you asked for. Highlights: 

- Acceptance milestones: added milestone owners (HealthCore QA / Redwood CS / Product) and proposed hard dates through 2026-11-30.
- Audit evidence: we can provide SOC 2 snapshot, access logs export, and a redacted request flow now; HSM/KMS proofs will be delivered within 30 days of signed MSA.
- Contingency: proposed go-live credit (1 week free runtime credit per week of slip, up to 4 weeks) if acceptance extends beyond 11/30.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the milestone owners and a preferred acceptance sign-off date by Fri 10/08 EOD.
2) If procurement still requests MSA language changes, we ask for the redlines and I'll escalate to our legal/ops team by EOD Fri.

Ben / Laura — looping you for awareness so we can prepare the legal/ops answers if HealthCore wants redlines.

Neha Kapoor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(neha_kapoor@redwood.com)
Attachments: HealthCore_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), procurement_questions_20261007.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2026 13:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing MAP and procurement questions for Q4 go-live

Neha — reviewed the attachments. Two quick items from ops/legal side: 
- Procurement is asking for a small change to our standard audit access clause (they want a 3rd-party auditor to run a focused audit for a single engagement window). That's not impossible but needs a scoped statement and an ops contact.
- The credit language you proposed is fine, but Finance will ask for a caps and notice period in the SOW.

If HealthCore returns redlines today, I'll take the package to Legal and Finance. If they come back with asks tomorrow, we should escalate to Jonas to request an approval lane (he's our exec sponsor for this deal).

Short answer: still possible to keep the 11/30 target, but we need the redlines today to avoid losing the PO window.

– Ben
Director, Sales Operations
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Finalizing MAP and procurement questions for HealthCore — request for exec lane

Jonas / Markus — forwarding the thread. HealthCore is ready to sign pending procurement redlines around audit access and a tightened acceptance schedule. Ben flagged Finance will want a cap on credits. 

Ask: can you review the attached MAP + procurement Q&A and approve an expedited legal review if HealthCore returns redlines before EOD Fri? We need an approval lane so Legal/Finance can accept a scoped auditor clause and the credit cap we discussed (cap at 4 weeks, notice within 5 business days of expected slip).

I've attached a suggested escalation checklist: 
- Prioritize legal review for scoped auditor language
- Confirm Finance credit cap (4 weeks) and the billing offset approach
- If redlines are extensive, approve a short-term bridge (30-day trial extension) to preserve PO timing

If you prefer, I can jump on a 15-min call this morning to walk through the specific clauses.

Thanks — pushing to keep the 11/30 go-live intact.

Neha Kapoor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: HealthCore_MAP_v3.xlsx, procurement_questions_20261007.pdf
From: Peter Lane <peter.lane@healthcore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tracy Wu <tracy.wu@healthcore.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing MAP and procurement questions for Q4 go-live

Neha / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the checklist. Procurement finished an initial pass and attached a single-page redline summary (they will send clean redlines Monday if we agree to scoped auditor terms).

We can live with the scoped auditor clause (single engagement window, auditor bound by NDA) and agree to the credit cap you proposed. With that, HealthCore will prioritize legal approvals and push for a PO by Monday 10/11.

As a safeguard, we'd like a single-week extension option (no penalty) if a final technical acceptance test (UAT) slips by less than 7 days. Can Redwood confirm this operationally? If so, we will proceed with the PO and route the redlines Monday for your team to act on.

Proposed next steps:
- HealthCore sends clean MSA redlines Mon 10/11 morning
- Redwood confirms 1-week no-penalty extension operationally by Mon 10/11 EOD or provides alternative
- Sign-off target: 10/15 for MSA execution, 11/30 go-live remains our committed target

Appreciate the responsiveness — Peter
